newsitem.title: CANADA: Cut employment insurance rates - Canadian business.
newsitem.headline: Cut employment insurance rates - Canadian business.

text.p: One of Canada's leading business groups asked the federal government on Friday to cut the employment insurance taxes since the insurance account will have a C$5 billion surplus by the end of the year.

Alliance of Manufacturers and Exporters Canada, representing 75 percent of Canada's manufactured output, suggested the employee rate be cut by at least 50 cents to C$2.45 per C$100 earned, and that the employer's rate be cut proportionately to C$3.43 from $4.13.
"A reduction in this payroll tax would help to create a more positive business environment, and it would help reduce the cost of employment," the alliance said.
The federal government has resisted big cuts so that it can build up a reserve for the next economic downturn.
